item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: AI #195: Opening Bell
item.description: Anthropic IPO day, a flood of new models (Fable 5.2, GPT-6.2, Gemini 4 Neon), and the wave of “not a cyberattack” outages Zvi calls The Hackening — plus the accelerating case for AI R&D self-improvement arriving in 2027.

item.title: Cory Doctorow: How to forfeit one of copyright’s best labor policies
item.description: Termination of transfer is copyright’s rare artist-friendly rule, letting creators reclaim rights after 35 years — but studios are using loan-out companies to argue the work was “made for hire” and kill it in court.
